create_render_to_text_as_root: render a Treescope root node to plain text with optional roundtrip and whitespace stripping
create_render_to_html_as_root: render a Treescope root node to HTML with optional roundtrip and compression
create_display_streaming_as_root: display a Treescope root node in an IPython notebook with deferred rendering support
create_maybe_defer_rendering: defer rendering of expensive parts until after tree structure is drawn in interactive contexts
create_collecting_deferred_renderings: collect deferred rendering calls via context manager for streaming HTML output
